reading.title: PRINCE GEORGE'S COUNTY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORT CR-041-2023

candidates.quote: The Owner is an entity to be formed by Developer: HAPGC Affordable H ousing Development Corporation, LLC C/O Housing Authority of Prince George's County for the purpose of acquiring and rehabilitating the Project, which is an existing one hundred (100) unit affordable multi -family rental housing for low-income to moderate-income families, known as Cottage City Towers, located at 4142 Bunker Hill Road, Cottage City, Maryland 20722.
All units will be reserved for households earning sixty percent (60%) or less of the Area Median Income ("AMI").
All units will be reserved for households earning sixty percent (60%) or less of the Area Median Income ("AMI").
candidates.wording: earning sixty percent (60%) or less of the Area Median Income

candidates.quote: Factoring in the 2% estimated average annual increase in the property tax assessment, the total impact is estimated at $3,351,766.00 over the 30 years that the PILOT agreement remains in effect.

CR -041-2023 seeks the approval of the terms and conditions of a Payments in Lieu of Taxes ("PILOT") Agreement between Prince George's County (the "County") and an entity to be formed by Developer: HAPGC Affordable Housing Development Corporation, LLC C/O Housing Authority of Prince George's County (the "Owner") concerning the Cottage City Towers Apartments (the "Project").
candidates.wording: Payments in Lieu of Taxes ("PILOT") Agreement

candidates.quote: The Project will also be financed with a Prince George's County Housing Investment Trust Fund ("HITF") loan in the amount of two million, five hundred thousand dollars ($2,500,000).
candidates.wording: Housing Investment Trust Fund ("HITF") loan in the amount of two million, five hundred thousand dollars ($2,500,000)

candidates.quote: As described above, accepting the PILOT on the entire Project of $0 will result in a loss of approximately $82,621 in the first year of the term.
candidates.wording: accepting the PILOT on the entire Project of $0
